entities.summary: The Our Lady of Carmel Cathedral Also Jaboticabal Cathedral Is located in Joaquim Batista Square, in Jaboticabal, Sao Paulo State in southern Brazil. It is a temple of the Catholic Church, the seat of the diocese of Jaboticabal and is considered the zero zone of the city. It is dedicated to the Virgin of Mount Carmel, patron saint of Jaboticabal.
